title: mri_fwhm
description: FreeSurfer program to estimate the global Gaussian smoothness of a multi-frame, volume-based data set.

inputvol.description: Input volume file. Format must be something readable by mri_convert (e.g., mgh, mgz, img, nii, nii.gz).
inputvol.title: Input Volume

outputvol.description: Output volume file: save input after smoothing.
outputvol.title: Output Volume

save_detrended.description: Save input after smoothing and detrending.
save_detrended.title: Save Detrended Flag

smooth_only.description: Smooth and save, do not compute fwhm.
smooth_only.title: Smooth Only Flag

auto_mask.description: Auto compute mask based on global mean threshold.
auto_mask.title: Auto Mask

nerode.description: Erode mask n times prior to FWHM computation.
nerode.title: Erode Mask Times

detrend_matrix.description: Detrending matrix file in MATLAB4 format.
detrend_matrix.title: Detrend Matrix

square_input.description: Compute square of input before smoothing.
square_input.title: Square Input Flag

median_filter.description: Perform median filtering instead of Gaussian.
median_filter.title: Median Filter Width

to_fwhm_nmax.description: Maximum iterations for smoothing to FWHM (default 20).
to_fwhm_nmax.title: To FWHM Max Iterations

to_fwhm_file.description: Save smoothing to FWHM parameters to file.
to_fwhm_file.title: To FWHM File

dat_file.description: Prints only the final FWHM estimate into this file.
dat_file.title: DAT File

fwhm_dat_file.description: Compute and save the FWHM of each dimension.
fwhm_dat_file.title: FWHM DAT File

fwhm_vol_mean_file.description: Compute and save the FWHM of each dimension based on fwhmvol.
fwhm_vol_mean_file.title: FWHM Volume Mean File

synth.description: Synthesize input with white Gaussian noise.
synth.title: Synthesize Input Flag

synth_frames.description: Number of frames for synthesized input (default is 10).
synth_frames.title: Synthesize Frames

nframes_min.description: Require at least this many frames.
nframes_min.title: Minimum Frames

checkopts.description: Check options and exit without running.
checkopts.title: Check Options Flag
